changelog:
AlphaGBM Macro View 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Track key macro indicators (VIX, US10Y, DXY, gold, oil, BTC, etc.) and see their real-time impact on your portfolio.
- Auto-generated impact analysis links each indicator directly to your holdings.
- Add, remove, and list tracked indicators with easy natural language triggers (English & Chinese supported).
- Get a live, categorized catalog of all supported macro indicators.
- Intuitive API endpoints and response formats; no profile setup required.
